user.title: Family Today
user.description: Choose a name for this instance and the calendars to combine into one 'today' view. Add the integration again with a different name for another household or dashboard.

people.title: Who owns each calendar?
people.description: One line per calendar: `calendar.entity = Person`. Edit the names as you like. {error}

abort.already_configured: That name is already in use. Pick a different name.

school_default.title: Shared school settings
school_default.description: Pick a school calendar (e.g. an ICS feed of school dates) or enter terms manually; manual terms are the fallback. Manual terms: one per line, `2026-11-02 to 2026-12-18 Autumn 2`. INSET days: dates separated by commas or new lines. The calendar is a list of days off: events containing a break keyword (holiday, half term, inset...) are non-school days, every other school weekday is a school day, and term-keyword events only name the term (single-day term starts/ends markers are ignored). {error}

data.school_break_keywords: Break keywords (default: holiday, half term, inset, closed, break...)

school_child.title: Per-child school calendar
school_child.description: Choose which child to configure. Their calendar overrides the shared school feed and keywords; weekdays, manual terms and INSET days stay shared.

school_child_form.title: School calendar for {person}
school_child_form.description: Pick this child's school calendar. Leave the calendar empty and save to remove the override. Leave the keywords blank to use the shared values.

bins.title: Bin collections
bins.description: Pick a Waste Collection Schedule calendar, or use manual rules. Aliases: `Refuse = General waste`. Colours and icons: `General waste | grey | mdi:trash-can` (name, colour, icon; either can be blank, and names match the displayed name after aliases). Manual rules: `General waste | thu | 2 | 2026-11-12` (name, weekday, every N weeks, a known collection date). Moves: `2026-12-24 -> 2026-12-23` or `-> skip`. {error}

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose the notify entity used by the `family_today.announce` action when a caller doesn't name one. This is also the default for the shipped morning-briefing and bins-out blueprints. Leave it empty to require a target on every call.

error.invalid_bins: Check the manual bin rule lines.

abort.no_people: Add at least one calendar owner before configuring per-child school settings.

family_today_school_card.name: School Calendar Card
family_today_school_card.no_school_breaks_in_calendar_yet: No school breaks in the calendar yet.

calendar_unavailable.title: Calendar unavailable: {entity_id}
calendar_unavailable.description: Family Today has not been able to read `{entity_id}` for several refreshes. Last error: {error}. The card keeps showing the last saved events for today where possible.
